caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL.) under different “Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims” ratio settings, showing two series labeled “Transformer” and “MoHD.” The x-axis is labeled “Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims” and uses a discrete set of ratio categories at evenly spaced positions: 0/4, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, and 4/4. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.” on a linear scale, spanning approximately from 10.0 up to 12.5, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.5 intervals. The “Transformer” series is drawn as a red dashed horizontal line with no visible markers, remaining constant at roughly 11.65 across all x-axis categories. The “MoHD” series is drawn as a blue solid line with square markers, starting near 11.1 at 0/4, decreasing to about 10.65 at 1/4 and about 10.5 at 2/4, reaching a low around 10.25 at 3/4, and then increasing to roughly 10.75 at 4/4.
